whenToUse: A plan priced on two axes — box size by delivery frequency, room by booking length, tier by contract term — where the visitor picks one cell.
Showing every combination's price at once so the cheapest rhythm or size is obvious.
avoidWhen: One axis only — use radio-group (card variant) or pricing-table.
Comparing features per plan — use comparison-table.
More than about six columns on phones — split one axis into a separate radio group.
a11y: One radio group with a single tab stop: arrow keys move in both axes (mirrored in RTL), Home / End to the row ends, unavailable cells are skipped and marked aria-disabled.
Each cell's accessible name carries its row, column and price, so the choice is read as coordinates.
